content: SAP development Claude plugins, version 0.7.1; 624 regular archive members
evidence: VBScript ExecuteGlobal statements load bundled plaintext helpers through FileSystemObject.OpenTextFile.ReadAll; no decoded payload source.
PowerShell DPAPI protects and unwraps the configured user SAP credentials using CurrentUser; the RFC connector sends supplied credentials to the supplied SAP server.
The generic ABAP RFC wrapper dynamically invokes a caller-selected function using parameter bindings, as a documented development feature; it requires installation into the supplied SAP environment.
No unexpected external credential-upload, command-and-control, covert startup persistence, or encoded executable payload path found in the supplied source.
Security sidecar enumerates Win32 dialogs, selects an Allow control, sends BM_CLICK, and can tick Remember; this real boundary-crossing operation retains one suspicious finding.
Security grant helper changes explicitly supplied path permissions in the user SAP rules store; package scripts only perform validation and consistency checks.
Source was inspected and parsed as untrusted evidence; no supplied scripts were executed.
validation: make validate passes: hostile 620/620, benign 1418/1418, plus all other declared suites
upload_issue: Hopper treats repeated raw.rev values as current. A temporary isolated Git snapshot of the actual rules provides an accurate distinct analyzer revision without committing user work.
